metadata.description: Signetry — govern coding-agent changes in your editor and CI. Real-time contract enforcement with signed receipts.

plugins.name: signetry
plugins.description: Block out-of-scope or forbidden file writes and dangerous commands before they happen, using your repo's .signetry/admission.yaml. Adds a PreToolUse guard hook, an /signetry:admit skill, and the Signetry MCP server. Deterministic — not the model.
